title: A Robust Passive Target Localization for Substation Inspection of UAV in a GPS-denied Environment
authors: U. -S. Suh; T. -W. Kim; D. -H. Kang; K. -M. Lee; W. -S. Ra; T. Kim
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
